title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your countertop with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass and stabilized by a weighted base to help prevent tipping—an easy fit for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories spaces.

  • Freestanding convenience: requires no wall mounting
  • Solid brass construction: crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Stable, weighted base: helps prevent tipping during use
  • Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching
  • Finish flexibility: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs

  • Dimensions: 14-Inch H x 5-Inch W x 5-Inch L
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Paper towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Contemporary Counter Top Kitchen Paper Towel Holder
_previous.description: Complete your kitchen décor with this finely crafted counter top paper towel holder. Keep your counter top clutter free while adding the finishing touch to your space. Made of solid brass and provided with a lifetime finish to insure products will never rust.
